# AICtrlNet

> Open-core governed AI orchestration platform by Bodaty LLC. Coordinates AI agents, humans, and enterprise systems under unified governance. Model-independent across Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and local runtimes (Ollama, vLLM). MIT-licensed Community Edition.

## Core pages

- [Features](https://aictrlnet.com/features/): governance, orchestration, human-in-the-loop
- [Editions](https://aictrlnet.com/editions/): Community (MIT), Business, Enterprise
- [Docs](https://aictrlnet.com/docs/): developer documentation
- [FAQ](https://aictrlnet.com/faq/): buyer questions answered directly
- [Blog](https://aictrlnet.com/blog/): essays on governed AI orchestration
- [Runtime Governance](https://aictrlnet.com/runtime-governance/): governing AI agents at runtime

- [HitLai](https://hitlai.net/): the SMB product built on AICtrlNet
